Samples and platforms of GEO series

Source: R/sradb.R
geo_samples.Rd

The GEOmetadb join of gse_gsm, gsm and gpl as one call.

Usage

geo_samples(con, gse)

Arguments

con

A connection from omicidx_connect(), or an omicidx_db().

gse

character. GEO series accessions.

Value

A tibble with one row per series and sample: gse, gsm, sample title, gpl, platform_title, organism, source, molecule, sample type, library_source, biosample and sra_experiment.

Examples

con <- omicidx_connect()
geo_samples(con, "GSE164073")
